title: Phawar of the Wedding & Archery Grounds (Phawar Kynjoh Khaskhain)
khasi_title: Phawar Kynjoh Khaskhain bad Ka Siat Khnam
composer: Oral Phawar Masters (Ki Nongphawar) of Sohra & Khyrim
cultural_context: Ka Phawar is the indigenous Khasi rhymed poetic banter and call-and-response couplet chanted with jubilant shouts of 'Hoiw-kiw!' during archery competitions (Ka Siat Khnam), victory celebrations, harvest feasts, and wedding processions (Ka Shongkurim). Each couplet balances a humorous or nature-derived opening line with a sharp, moral, or congratulatory punchline.
lyrics_khasi:
Ko kynjoh khaskhaiñ, ka pylleng ka 'iar-kpa!
Iap phet ki ksew, phai khmat ki myrsiang;
Hoiw-kiw! To siat beit beit sha ka thong!
U khnam u la thwet, u la ngam ha pdeng!

Ka thwei ka kynjah, ka ktieh ka ba-jylliew,
U shynrang bashlur u la jop ia ka thong;
Hoiw-kiw! Kiew spah kiew phew ka kur ka jait,
Ka burom ka nam kan sah pateng la pateng!

Ka tympew ka dula, u kwai u ba-thiang,
U kñi u la wan pyniasoh ia ka kur;
Hoiw-kiw! Ka shongkurim ba-khuid ba-sbun,
Ban roi ka kpoh, ban bun ki khun ki kti!

Ka wah um ba sngur, ka rupa ka ksiar,
Ka jingsuk kan shong ha ka dpei jong ka Ri;
Hoiw-kiw! Kynjoh khaskhaiñ baroh shikur,
Ha ka hok ka sot ngin iai shong suk!
lyrics_english:
Hail the rhyming phawar, the egg of the rooster bird!
Flee the stray dogs, turn the wild mountain foxes;
Hoiw-kiw! Shoot straight and true toward the target circle!
The feathered arrow hath flown and pierced the very center bullseye!

Deep is the mountain pool, soft is the river mud,
The valiant youth hath conquered the target tournament;
Hoiw-kiw! May wealth and fortune multiply for the matrilineal clan,
May honor and fame endure across generations unbroken!

Fragrant is the betel vine, sweet is the fresh areca nut,
The maternal uncle hath arrived to weave the clan alliance covenant;
Hoiw-kiw! A marriage pure, gracious, and sacred,
May the ancestral womb flourish and bear many children and descendants!

Clear is the mountain spring stream, precious are silver and gold,
May heavenly peace abide upon the hearthfires of the realm;
Hoiw-kiw! Let the whole clan chant the rhyming phawar together,
In truth and righteousness we shall ever dwell in peace!

stanzas.title: Ka Siat Khnam (The Archery Target Shot)
stanzas.khasi:
Ko kynjoh khaskhaiñ, ka pylleng ka 'iar-kpa!
Iap phet ki ksew, phai khmat ki myrsiang;
Hoiw-kiw! To siat beit beit sha ka thong!
U khnam u la thwet, u la ngam ha pdeng!
stanzas.english: Chant the phawar! Shoot straight toward the target; the arrow has struck the center bullseye to cheers of Hoiw-kiw!

stanzas.title: Ka Nam Ka Burom (Clan Honor and Victory)
stanzas.khasi:
Ka thwei ka kynjah, ka ktieh ka ba-jylliew,
U shynrang bashlur u la jop ia ka thong;
Hoiw-kiw! Kiew spah kiew phew ka kur ka jait,
Ka burom ka nam kan sah pateng la pateng!
stanzas.english: The brave youth wins the tournament; clan wealth and fame shall flourish generation after generation.

stanzas.title: Ka Shongkurim (The Wedding Covenant)
stanzas.khasi:
Ka tympew ka dula, u kwai u ba-thiang,
U kñi u la wan pyniasoh ia ka kur;
Hoiw-kiw! Ka shongkurim ba-khuid ba-sbun,
Ban roi ka kpoh, ban bun ki khun ki kti!
stanzas.english: With betel nut and leaf the maternal uncle seals the clan marriage; may the matrilineal womb flourish with many children.

stanzas.title: Ka Jingsuk Ha Ka Dpei (Peace on the Hearth)
stanzas.khasi:
Ka wah um ba sngur, ka rupa ka ksiar,
Ka jingsuk kan shong ha ka dpei jong ka Ri;
Hoiw-kiw! Kynjoh khaskhaiñ baroh shikur,
Ha ka hok ka sot ngin iai shong suk!
stanzas.english: May peace abide upon the hearths of the fatherland; let all clans chant together, dwelling forever in truth and harmony.

vocabulary.phawar: Rhymed couplet chant or poetic banter recited rhythmically during archery matches, feasts, and ceremonies
vocabulary.kynjoh khaskhain: The traditional opening invocation and rhythmic exclamation signaling the start of phawar
vocabulary.hoiw-kiw: The triumphant Khasi victory roar and cheer raised in unison
vocabulary.ka thong: The target or bullseye in archery competitions (Ka Siat Khnam)
vocabulary.ka shongkurim: Matrimony; customary marriage alliance between two exogamous matrilineal clans
